These tiny two-second recordings are original sine tones generated by `tools/generate-audio-fixtures.py` and `tools/generate-alac-fixture.py`. They contain no sampled or copyrighted music. The folder includes tagged and untagged MP3, FLAC, M4A/ALAC, OGG, WAV and AIFF, nested/disc folders, junk filenames, an original `cover.png` and an `.lrc` sidecar.

The optional generator uses SoundFile 0.13.1/libsndfile and NumPy. Generated files are committed, so those tools are not required by builds, tests, the app or either server. The browser demo separately generates longer original audio with OfflineAudioContext.
